name: Motorcycle
description: A motorcycle or motor tricycle as the federal Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations define them; Saskatchewan has no moped class, so an electric two-wheeler past the power-assisted bicycle's limits that can reach 32 km/h, from a fast e-bike to an e-moto, is one.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels, and no limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: The Vehicle Equipment Regulations, 1987, R.R.S. c. V-2.1 Reg 10, s. 2(1)(dd); Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1038, s. 2(1)

restrictions.rule: Anything over 500 W, without working pedals, or gas-powered is a motorcycle rather than a power-assisted bicycle
Riders need a driver's licence with a "6" learner or "M" motorcycle endorsement, from age 16
restrictions.citation: The Driver Licensing and Suspension Regulations, 2006, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 2, ss. 11(11) and 19.2(1)(a)

restrictions.rule: A "6" endorsement holder may not carry passengers, tow, or ride from half an hour before sunset to half an hour after sunrise; a novice 1 "M" holder may not carry passengers, tow, or ride between midnight and 5 a.m.
restrictions.citation: The Driver Licensing and Suspension Regulations, 2006, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 2, ss. 19.6 and 19.7

restrictions.rule: Every rider and passenger must wear a strapped-on helmet meeting ANSI, BSI, CSA, DOT, Snell or ECE standards, and goggles, glasses or a face shield; the operator is exempt from eye protection behind a windshield
restrictions.citation: The Traffic Safety Act, S.S. 2004, c. T-18.1, s. 247(1) and (2); The Vehicle Equipment Regulations, 1987, R.R.S. c. V-2.1 Reg 10, s. 6.1(1), (2.1), (3) and (4)

restrictions.rule: A "6" or novice "M" rider and any passenger must also cover their arms and legs and wear a three-quarter, modular or full-face helmet, ankle boots and full-fingered gloves
restrictions.citation: The Vehicle Equipment Regulations, 1987, R.R.S. c. V-2.1 Reg 10, s. 6.1(1.1)

restrictions.rule: A passenger needs a saddle built for two or a pillion seat and separate footrests they can reach; nobody rides side saddle or in front of the driver
restrictions.citation: The Traffic Safety Act, S.S. 2004, c. T-18.1, s. 247(3) and (4)

restrictions.rule: Registered with SGI in Class LV
restrictions.citation: The Vehicle Classification and Registration Regulations, R.R.S. c. H-3.1 Reg 3, s. 16.1(2)(a)

restrictions.rule: One built only for off-highway use is an all terrain vehicle instead
restrictions.citation: The All Terrain Vehicles Act, S.S. 1988-89, c. A-18.02, s. 2(1)(b) and (s)
